event: A diagnostic schema-inspection command intended to print token, latency, and telemetry fields also printed calls[0:2].request and calls[0:2].generation.raw_output for the first row of condition r1-o1 because the filter did not remove nested fields.

impact.rationale: The complete campaign and score-blind admission were already immutable. No resource aggregate, method difference, hidden label, or official reference was accessed. The resource analysis remains bound to the pre-existing code-plan, study-protocol, hardware-protocol, and accuracy-protocol decisions.

mitigations: Use an explicit allowlist when deriving resource metric rows.
Reject any derived-row schema containing request, prompt, message, response, text, raw_output, or model-output fields.
Store only identifiers and numeric resource metrics in analysis outputs.
Do not claim that no human raw-output inspection occurred after resource admission.
